name: Angus McGregor
bio:
Angus McGregor's path to motorsport PR was a bit unconventional. After a decade in retail management, he volunteered at a local V8 Supercars event and discovered a passion he never knew he had. The roar of the engines, the intensity of the competition, and the stories surrounding the drivers captivated him. He began taking online courses in public relations and leveraging his management experience to offer his services to smaller racing teams.

Angus is now committed to building compelling narratives for his clients. He believes in meticulous planning and targeted communication, leaving no stone unturned in his quest to secure positive media coverage and boost brand awareness. He sees himself as a storyteller first and foremost, finding the human element in every race and translating it into engaging content for fans and sponsors alike.

While still developing his network and refining his strategies, Angus brings a unique blend of real-world business acumen and genuine enthusiasm to the world of motorsport PR. He's determined to prove that hard work and a relentless pursuit of excellence can overcome any obstacle.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Angus is a stocky man with a friendly face and a persistent twinkle in his eyes.

quirks: Insists on using a physical notepad and pen for brainstorming, even in meetings.
Always wears a racing team hat, regardless of whether he's representing them at the moment.
Has a habit of quoting obscure racing trivia at unexpected times.
